title: Is FM27 Free to Play? No — the Free Window Closed on 3 November
description: Football Manager 27 is not free to play. The five-day Launch Preview ran 29 October to 3 November 2026, the game released on 10 November, and there is no demo, trial or free weekend running now.
h1: FM27 Launch Preview after the free window
meta: Updated 13 November 2026 · Free Launch Preview closed 3 November 2026 · Full release 10 November 2026 · No free access is running at the time of this check.
body:
No. FM27 is not free to play, and there is no demo or free weekend running. The free-for-everyone Launch Preview ran for five days at the end of October and closed on 3 November 2026. The game then released on 10 November. If a page tells you otherwise, check its date.

What was free, and when

WindowDatesStatus now
Free Launch Preview (PC/Mac, all game modes)29 October 18:00 GMT – 3 November 18:00 GMT 2026Closed
Paid Launch Preview (pre-purchasers, Game Pass)3 November – 10 November 2026Ended at release
Released gameFrom 10 November 2026Current — paid, or via Game Pass
Demo / trial / free weekendNone announcedNot available

Cheapest legitimate routes in

  • PC Game Pass or Game Pass Ultimate — FM27 (PC/Mac) is included, and the console edition is included with Game Pass Console. This is the cheapest way to play if you already subscribe.
  • Buy once on PC/Mac — Steam, Epic or the Microsoft Store. Steam showed $59.99 in the US on 13 November 2026 with no discount.
  • Subscription editions — FM27 Touch is inside Apple Arcade and FM27 Mobile is inside Netflix. Both require the subscription and neither is a purchase.

Do not buy a “free FM27 key” from a reseller. There is no free edition to key, and the Launch Preview windows are closed.

If you played the free window

  1. Your save still works: Sports Interactive confirmed Launch Preview saves continue into the released game.
  2. Continuing it needs an owned copy or a Game Pass subscription — the save carrying over does not carry access with it.
  3. If you want the released database untouched, start a new save instead of continuing the Preview one.

What to install first, now that you own it

The real-name fix is the one change worth making before a long save, and the install-path checker gives you the folder for your platform before you download anything. Logos and skins can wait until you have seen the interface once.
